title: Diverse Corpus, Performance & Interoperability Proof
objective: Complete the final MAI proof tranche as read-only composition over MAI-01..09, proving representative provider-neutral corpus coverage, explicit degraded/fail-closed behavior, approved-budget performance and deterministic interoperability without creating owner truth or a new durable ledger.

resolved_contract.corpus: All fourteen MAI-01 source classes plus bounded Tiled/LDtk/Foundry adapter cases, completed projection/geometry families, MAI-07 availability/resolution outcomes, MAI-08 reversible drafts and MAI-09 owner-integration outcomes were represented with source/license/permission/provenance evidence preserved.
resolved_contract.negative_degraded: Unsupported, ambiguous, partial, invalid, denied/unknown/revoked, incompatible/unverified, visibly-unresolved, gridless-autotile-undefined, stale-owner and ambiguous-owner cases remained explicit and fail closed.
resolved_contract.performance: Self-hosted Linux and Windows each used the approved bounded-corpus search/filter <150 ms median target; raw platform timings remained evidence only and were excluded from deterministic truth. Other MAI-specific operations were measured/report-only because no approved numerical budget exists for them.
resolved_contract.interoperability: Applicable MAI-01 through MAI-09 stages either preserved evidence through the proof or terminated in an explicit supported negative/degraded state; unsupported capability was never guessed into existence.
resolved_contract.determinism: Canonical corpus identities, stage verdicts, diagnostics, owner-boundary booleans and normalized approved-budget verdicts produced one platform-neutral receipt shared by Linux and Windows.
resolved_contract.persistence: No MAI-owned durable corpus, benchmark or interoperability ledger was required; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.owner_boundaries: MIB-11/D18 World, A5 Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions, Combat/Exploration/Action and D29 publication/provenance authority remained unchanged.

repair_history: Aligned the governed MAI-10 report to exact MAI-06 adapter IDs without weakening verify_mai_10.py.
Changed the partial-import proof from label-only evidence to a real MAI-06 multi-level LDtk partial import carrying the ldtk-multi-level-partial diagnostic and raw-source preservation.
completion_evidence.validation_recovery: A content-identical native synchronize registered the canonical exact-head workflows. The owner-approved Windows-to-WSL recovery path re-established/verified multiversal-linux-02 without changing the application candidate; runner recovery is infrastructure evidence rather than a code repair cycle.

preserved_boundaries: MAI-01..09 completed evidence remains binding and has no further implementation authority
MAI-10 is completed_verified and has no further implementation authority

MIB-11/D18 owns World; A5 owns runtime Scene; Visibility/Permissions owns visibility; Combat/Exploration and Action owners own gameplay; D29 owns publication/provenance

next_action: Closed. MAI-10 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority. The MAI program is complete; AAI-01 is selected_not_started only and requires a future governed start before implementation.
